answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 38107 Country: United States of America Title: sajda-e-tilawah Question: Does qadhaa have to be done for sajda-e-tilawah if it had not been done in the past years? Answer ID: 38107 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 686/576/B=1433) Yes, performing the sajda tilawat is wajib. If someone missed the sajdah in past, he or she should perform the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
